visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a brown sweater stands on a busy urban street in front of a Lawson convenience store. He waves energetically at the camera while smiling widely, gesturing toward the store behind him. (2) He holds up a packaged yellow and white dessert bag directly to the lens, showing the image of a canelé on the front. He looks excited, glancing between the product and the camera. (3) A close-up view focuses on the man's hand holding a single, dark brown, ridged canelé. He rotates it slightly to show the texture. (4) The man brings the canelé to his nose, closing his eyes briefly as he inhales the scent, then looks back at the camera with an impressed facial expression. (5) He takes a large bite of the dessert, chewing with wide eyes and a look of surprise and delight. (6) He holds the half-eaten canelé close to the camera, revealing the pale yellow, porous interior texture while pointing at it with his other hand. (7) He continues to eat and speak enthusiastically, making a 'thumb up' gesture and smiling as he finishes the clip in the same outdoor street setting.
